messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑French Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **Tant'** | Intensifier indicating a high degree of bitterness | **Tellement** | “so / very” | OK | | **è** (1st) | Copular verb linking subject to predicate “bitter” | **est‑elle** | “is (it)” | OK | | **amara** | Predicate adjective describing bitterness | **amère** | “bitter” | OK | | **che** (comparative) | Conjunction introducing the comparative clause | **que** | “that” | OK | | **poco** | Adverb quantifier expressing a small amount (“little”) | **que** | “only / merely” | OK | | **è** (2nd) | Copular verb in the comparative clause | **n’est** | “is not” (part of *n’est que*) | OK | | **più** | Comparative adverb indicating “more” | **plus** | “more” | OK | | **morte** | Noun, the entity “death” | **mort** | “death” | OK | | **ma** | Coordinating conjunction signalling contrast | **mais** | “but” | OK | | **per** | Preposition introducing a purpose infinitive | **pour** | “for / in order to” | OK | | **trattar** | Infinitive “to treat” | **traiter** | “to treat” | OK | | **del** | Contraction *di + il* → “of the” | **du** | “of the” | OK | | **ben** | Noun “good” (object of treatment) | **bien** | “good” | OK | | **ch'i'** | Relative pronoun “that I” | **que** | “that” | OK | | **vi** | Locative adverb “there” | **là** | “there” | OK | | **trovai** | Past‑historic verb “found” | **trouvé** | “found” | OK | | **dirò** | Future verb “will tell” | **dirai** | “I will tell” | OK | | **de** | Preposition “of” (introducing the topic) | **des** | “of the” (partitive) | OK | | **l'altre** | Adjective “other” | **autres** | “other” | OK | | **cose** | Noun “things” | **choses** | “things” | OK | | **v'ho** | Auxiliary + locative “have (there)” | **j’ai** | “I have” | OK | | **scorte** | Past participle “seen” | **vues** | “seen” | OK |
### Missing / Wrong Items None – every source token is accounted for and correctly aligned with its French counterpart.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line 7** - **Original Translation:** `Tellement amère est‑elle que la mort n’est que légèrement plus;` - **Issues:** In the word‑to‑French table the source token **poco** was incorrectly aligned with **« que »**. It should be aligned with **« légèrement »** (the adverb that conveys “little”). - **Corrected Translation:** *no change needed* (the French sentence already expresses “little more” with **légèrement**).
**Line 8** - **Original Translation:** `mais pour traiter du bien que j’ai trouvé là,` - **Issues:** none. - **Corrected Translation:** *no change needed*.
**Line 9** - **Original Translation:** `je dirai des autres choses que j’ai vues là.` - **Issues:** none. - **Corrected Translation:** *no change needed*.

```text Tellement amère est‑elle que la mort n’est que légèrement plus; mais pour traiter du bien que j’ai trouvé là, je dirai des autres choses que j’ai vues là. ```
